knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the customer buys getting back in, and certainty about the full price. Your van, machine, hourly rate alone and years in the trade are not what the customer buys.

The lesson says a guarantee must be something you can deliver and afford, such as a return visit for a stated period that you set from your own records. An open-ended or impossible guarantee does not meet this.
The lesson says a lockout advertised at $29 usually covers the attendance only, not the work. The rest of the job is priced separately.
